name: Improved Radiant Cascade is a native spell modifier on Radiant Cascade only (#1099)
contract: Spell.dbc 807963 ("Improved Radiant Cascade", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) has two SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effects, both keyed to EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 32768, which a repository-wide Spell.dbc scan for family-33 spells shows matches only the Radiant Cascade chain (500141 Rank 1 .. 502411 Rank 6) and nothing else. Effect 0 is EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectBasePoints -16 (amount -15); effect 1 is EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, the generic value modifier the engine also applies to healing) with EffectBasePoints 14 (amount 15). Player::ApplySpellMod's SPELLMOD_PCT branch (Player.cpp:10219) computes basevalue = basevalue*totalmul + totalflat: for a single -15% modifier, totalmul = 0.85, so base 1000 reads back 850; for a single +15% modifier on SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, totalmul *= (100+15)/100 = 1.15, so base 1000 reads back 1150. This is a fully generic native pipeline; no server script exists or is needed, and the class mask keeps it off unrelated family-33 spells such as Horusath Blast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Radiant Cascade's mana cost is reduced by 15%
Radiant Cascade's healing is increased by 15%
An unrelated family-33 spell (Horusath Blast) keeps its normal cost
